QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] The First Captain's Meeting
QuestInfo.0: Your first meeting as captain will begin soon. #p9201716# is waiting for you.
QuestInfo.1: The new captain of Pente has been formally introduced! Curiously, #p9201713# seems to have already been aware that dark monsters have been appearing.
QuestInfo.2: #p9201713# told you that it's the duty of a captain to safeguard the people of Helia, and asked you to check if there was anything suspicious around the residential area. You went to #m693007002# to meet the residents.
